title: Beauty and the Beast
summary: A kind girl trades a small plant for a chance to help her struggling family.
coverScene: A gentle young woman stands inside a large magical castle holding a single bright red flower.

sentences.text: Once upon a time, a rich man lived in a big town with his lovely children.
After bad business hit the family, they lost their money and moved into a small house far away.
While the sisters complained about their new life, the youngest daughter named Beauty worked hard and always smiled.
She was very good to everyone in the family.
Every single day, she helped her father and sisters with many different tasks around the small house.
The family had very little money left, but Beauty always tried to keep everyone happy and full of belief about the future.
Her older sisters often sat around and cried about their lost wealth, but Beauty never did that.
Instead, she cooked meals, cleaned the rooms, and made sure that her father felt loved.
The father often looked at his youngest daughter with great pride and deep feeling.
He knew that life would be much harder without her gentle help and constant smile.
They spent many quiet evenings together by the small fire, talking about better times.
Although their clothes were old and simple, they still shared a strong family bond that money could never buy.
One day, the father heard that a ship with his goods had finally arrived at the port.
Before he left, he asked his children what kind of present they wanted him to bring back.
The older sisters requested expensive clothes and gold, but Beauty only asked for a simple red flower.
She did not care about gold or fine dresses because she was happy with very little.
The father promised that he would search everywhere for that special flower.
He told his daughters farewell and walked down the road toward the busy port.
The weather was cold, and the wind blew hard against his face as he traveled.
He hoped that the news about his ship was true so that he could buy new things for his family.
He wanted to give his children a better life and take away their daily worries.
The journey was long, and he felt quite tired by the time he reached the large town by the sea.
He walked quickly through the busy streets until he finally arrived at the harbor area.
Ships came and went all day, carrying goods from distant countries across the deep blue water.
When the man reached the port, he found that his goods were gone and he had nothing.
During his dark and cold journey home through the forest, he lost his way in deep snow.
Suddenly, he saw a large castle which was bright with lights and full of food on a big table.
The man entered the warm building, ate a nice meal, and slept in a comfortable bed.
The next morning, as he walked outside, he saw a beautiful garden and picked a red flower for Beauty.
Immediately, a terrible creature appeared, shouting that he would kill the man for stealing his property.
The huge animal looked very angry, and his loud voice shook the ground beneath the man feet.
The frightened father explained that the flower was only a small gift for his youngest daughter.
The strange creature agreed to let him go if one of his daughters came to live in the castle freely.
The poor father felt very sad, but he knew that he had no other choice to see his family again.
He made the promise and quickly ran away from the dark place as fast as he could.
When the merchant returned home, Beauty decided to leave her life there and travel to the strange castle to save her father.
Although the creature looked frightening, he treated Beauty with great care and gave her a lovely room.
Every evening they talked together, and Beauty began to feel deep love for the strange animal.
However, after she saw in a special glass that her father was sick, she asked to visit him.
She told the master of the castle that she missed her family very much and needed to see her father.
The creature allowed her to go home for a short time, but she had to promise that she would return soon.
Her family was extremely happy to see her, but her stay became too long because she enjoyed being with them.
Suddenly, she remembered the creature, and she rushed back to the castle because she was afraid that he was dead.
She ran through the dark forest and entered the castle gardens as fast as possible.
The wind blew cold around her, and her heart beat fast with fear and worry.
She searched every corner of the large garden, calling out his name into the cold night air.
The place was completely quiet, and no one answered her calls for a long time.
She feared that her long delay had caused him too much pain while she was away from the castle.
She found the poor creature down in the garden, and she cried while she held him closely.
Beauty told the creature that she loved him, and her love broke the dark spell.
The animal immediately changed into a young prince, and they lived happily together forever.
The prince thanked Beauty for her great love and deep care during such a difficult time.
He explained how a bad spell had kept him in that terrible shape until someone could love him despite his looks.
The old castle transformed into a bright and happy place filled with light and music.
Soon after that happy event, Beauty brought her father and sisters to live with them in the grand house.
The family never had to worry about money or food ever again.
The sisters learned to be kind and helpful, just like Beauty had always been.
They spent their days walking in the beautiful gardens and sharing wonderful meals together.
The prince and Beauty ruled the land with wisdom, love, and fairness for the rest of their lives.
Everyone in the country celebrated their happy union and remembered the story for many years.

sentences.text: Once upon a time, a wealthy merchant resided in a sprawling metropolis, surrounded by his cherished children and the opulence of his successful trade.
Unforeseen economic ruin struck the family mercilessly, stripping away their vast fortune and forcing a relocation to a modest, remote cottage far from civilization.
While the older sisters surrendered to perpetual lamentations regarding their fallen status, the youngest daughter, known simply as Beauty, embraced her strenuous new reality with quiet grace.
Not a single day passed without Beauty tending tirelessly to the household chores, offering an unwavering smile that brought warmth to their humble dwelling.
She cooked, cleaned, and comforted her brooding father, ensuring that affection remained the true currency of their impoverished household.
Her father often gazed upon his youngest child with profound admiration, acutely aware that their fractured lives would utterly collapse without her gentle resilience.
During long evenings spent beside a flickering fire, they reminisced about past splendors while finding solace in each other's unbroken company.
Though their garments were coarse and frayed, they shared a profound familial bond that no amount of lost wealth could ever replace.
Fate intervened one bleak morning when word reached the merchant that a merchant vessel bearing his long-lost cargo had finally docked at a distant port.
Before embarking on the arduous journey, he gathered his children to ask what tokens of affection they desired him to secure upon his return.
While the greedy sisters clamored for costly silks, jewels, and gold, Beauty requested nothing more elaborate than a simple red rose.
She harbored no desire for material extravagance, content instead with the quiet beauty of nature and the comfort of her family.
Her father promised faithfully to scour the marketplaces for that singular blossom before bidding his daughters a tender farewell.
Stepping out into the biting wind, he felt the chill of the winter air lash against his weathered face as he set off down the muddy road.
He prayed fervently that the rumors of his recovered cargo were true, desperate to restore financial security and spare his children further hardship.
The journey proved exhausting, testing the limits of his aging body as he traversed miles of rugged terrain toward the bustling coastal harbor.
Upon arrival, however, crushing disappointment awaited him; his cargo had been entirely seized by creditors, leaving him utterly destitute.
Left with empty pockets and a heavy heart, he began the long, solitary trek back through a dense forest as heavy winter snow began to fall.
Blindfolded by swirling blizzards, he lost his bearings completely until a sudden break in the trees revealed a massive, illuminated castle glowing warmly against the dark woods.
Drawn by the miraculous sight, he pushed open the heavy oak doors to find a lavish feast laid out upon a magnificent table, entirely unattended.
Overwhelmed by fatigue and hunger, the weary traveler partook of the magnificent meal before seeking refuge in a sumptuously prepared bedchamber.
The following morning, as he wandered through the castle courtyards, his eyes caught sight of a breathtaking garden overflowing with vibrant flora.
Remembering his promise, he snapped a single red rose from its stem, intending to present it to Beauty upon his reunion.
Scarcely had the flower left the bush when a terrifying beast materialized before him, roaring with a fury that shook the very stones beneath his feet.
The monstrous creature accused the trembling merchant of ungrateful theft, declaring that the penalty for such audacity must surely be death.
Groveling in terror, the desperate father explained that the plucked blossom was merely a humble token requested by his youngest daughter.
The beast considered the plea before offering a harsh ultimatum: the merchant's life would be spared only if one of his daughters willingly surrendered to imprisonment in the castle.
Knowing the impossibility of his choice, the heartbroken father accepted the cruel terms and fled the terrifying domain as swiftly as his legs could carry him.
When he finally arrived home and recounted the harrowing tale, Beauty made an immediate and resolute decision to sacrifice her own freedom to save her father.
She packed a modest bag and journeyed bravely into the forbidding wilderness, determined to fulfill the terrifying bargain.
Upon her arrival at the enchanted castle, the fearsome creature welcomed her not as a prisoner, but with surprising gentleness and respect.
He assigned her a magnificent chamber filled with books and music, ensuring her comfort while granting her total autonomy within the sprawling estate.
Every evening at dusk, they dined together, engaging in deep conversations that gradually dissolved Beauty's initial terror and replaced it with genuine affection.
Despite her growing contentment, a heavy shadow fell over her heart when a magical mirror revealed that her beloved father had fallen gravely ill.
She pleaded with the master of the castle for permission to visit her ailing family, promising upon her honor to return within a strictly limited timeframe.
The compassionate beast granted her request, though his sorrow was palpable as he watched her depart for the familiar embrace of her cottage.
Her family rejoiced at her return, showering her with affection and making it agonizingly difficult for her to tear herself away.
Blinded by the comfort of home, Beauty lost track of time, lingering far beyond the agreed-upon date until a sudden, chilling premonition struck her soul.
Panic surged through her veins as she remembered the lonely beast, terrified that her careless delay might have cost him his very life.
Without a moment's hesitation, she bolted out the door and raced desperately back through the dark, menacing forest toward the castle.
Arriving breathless at the gates, she rushed into the moonlit gardens, calling out his name into the chilling night air with mounting hysteria.
Only silence answered her frantic appeals, amplifying the suffocating dread that gripped her chest as she searched every shadowy corner of the estate.
At last, she discovered the lifeless form of the massive creature sprawled near the rose bushes, motionless upon the damp ground.
Sobbing uncontrollably, she collapsed beside him, pressing her face against his fur and whispering that she loved him with all her heart.
Scarcely had the confession escaped her lips when a blinding flash of light enveloped the garden, breaking the ancient curse that had bound him for ages.
To her utter astonishment, the monstrous beast melted away, replaced by a handsome prince whose grateful eyes locked onto hers with profound devotion.
He explained how a wicked witch had condemned him to wander in monstrous form until a pure soul could love him despite his hideous appearance.
The gloomy castle miraculously transformed, shedding its dark stone exterior to reveal a radiant palace echoing with joyous music and celebration.
Not long after, Beauty brought her father and humbled sisters to reside within the grand estate, ensuring their financial security for the rest of their days.
The reformed sisters learned the true value of humility and kindness, joining the royal family in peaceful harmony.
Years passed, but the kingdom continued to flourish under the wise and benevolent rule of the prince and his devoted queen.
Every corner of the realm celebrated their enduring union, whispering tales of how true love had conquered darkness and transformed despair into eternal joy.

Why did the merchant enter the mysterious castle in the forest?
options: He was seeking shelter from a blizzard after his cargo was seized.
He was hunting for a lost horse in the deep snow.
He received a formal invitation from the prince.

quiz.q: What event finally broke the dark curse that had transformed the prince into a beast?
options: The merchant returning the stolen flower to the garden
Beauty confessing her love for the creature as he lay dying
The wicked spell naturally expiring after a certain number of years
